## Implementation Complete

**Change:** `apply-coupon-to-order` (schema: spec-driven)
**Progress:** 9/9 tasks complete ✓ · `openspec validate --strict` passes · `npm run build` clean · **18/18 tests pass**

### Artifacts created (planning)
- `openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/proposal.md` — why/what, new `order-coupons` capability, impact
- `openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/specs/order-coupons/spec.md` — 9 requirements with scenarios covering the endpoint contract, each rejection rule, and both discount types
- `openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/design.md` — service ownership, validation order, 400-on-invalid decision, integer-cent arithmetic, persistence
- `openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/tasks.md` — 9 tracked tasks, all checked

### Code changes
- `src/routes/orders.ts` — `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` → 200 with the updated order
- `src/services/orderService.ts` — `applyCoupon`: validates coupon code, existence, `ACTIVE` status, validity window, minimum amount, usage limit (all HTTP 400); computes FIXED/PERCENT discount with `maxDiscountCents` cap and amount clamp; persists and records the redemption
- `src/repositories/orderRepository.ts` — `applyCoupon` writes `discount_cents` / `final_amount_cents` / `coupon_code`
- `src/repositories/couponRepository.ts` — `recordRedemption`, `incrementUsedCount`
- `src/app.ts` — injects `CouponRepository` into `OrderService`
- `tests/apply-coupon.test.ts` — 13 new tests (validation, FIXED, PERCENT, cap, clamp, redemption, 404)

`TASK.md`, `tests/orders.test.ts` and the requirement text were left untouched. No schema changes were needed.

### Notes on decisions
- Coupon failures return **400** (not the 404 used by `GET /coupons/:code`), per the acceptance criteria.
- I additionally honour the existing `maxDiscountCents` and `usageLimit` columns; both default to `NULL` (no-op), so they don't alter behavior for coupons created without them.

Tracked tasks are all complete. Per your instruction I stopped here rather than archiving; the change is ready to archive when you want it (`/opsx:archive`).
